name: Ratatouille with grilled chicken
steps: Dice the aubergine, courgette, pepper and onion into small cubes.
Soften the onion and garlic in olive oil, then add the pepper.
Stir in the aubergine and courgette and cook until they collapse.
Pour in the tinned tomatoes with a pinch of thyme and simmer 15 minutes.
Season the sliced chicken breast and grill until golden.
Spoon the ratatouille onto a plate and lay the chicken over it.
